widget.title: Chat widget
widget.description: Live chat on your site. Conversations land in the inbox as chat tickets, and replies reach the visitor instantly.
widget.settingsHint: When the widget shows, what it asks for and where it may load.
widget.showHint: Off hides the launcher everywhere, even with the script installed.
widget.greetingHint: The first thing visitors read on the home screen.
widget.greetingPlaceholder: Hi there. How can we help?
widget.introHint: Under the greeting when a visitor starts a new chat. Empty uses a translated default.
widget.introPlaceholder: Ask us anything. We'll reply here, and by email if you leave one.
widget.chatWelcome: Welcome text in a new chat
widget.chatWelcomeHint: Shows the greeting and intro at the top of a new chat. Off, the chat opens empty.
widget.requireEmailHint: Visitors leave an address before chatting, so you can follow up by email.
widget.originsHint: The widget only loads on these origins. Leave empty to allow any site.
widget.originInvalid: Enter a site address like https://example.com
widget.anySite: Loads on any site for now.
widget.installHint: Paste this before the closing body tag on every page that should show the widget.
widget.identifyHint: Optional. Links chats to the right contact and keeps their history across devices.
widget.secretHint: Rotating it invalidates every identify hash until your server uses the new one.
widget.avatarHint: Shown in the header. Without one, visitors see your workspace logo. Saves as soon as you upload it.
widget.launcherHint: Replaces the chat bubble on the launcher. Saves as soon as you upload it.
widget.appearanceHint: Colour, theme and where the launcher sits on your site.
widget.colorHint: The launcher, visitor bubbles and send button.
widget.positionHint: Which bottom corner the launcher sits in.
widget.offsetHint: From the side and from the bottom, 0 to 200 px.
widget.radiusHint: Of the panel, the bubbles and the launcher.
widget.launcherStyleHint: A round button, or a button with a short label.
widget.headerHint: The top of the open widget.
widget.titleHint: Leave empty to show your workspace name.
widget.subtitle: Subtitle
widget.subtitleHint: Leave empty to show how fast you usually reply.
widget.subtitlePlaceholder: We usually reply in a few minutes
widget.showTeamHint: Up to three teammates, first names only, available people first.
widget.homeHint: What visitors see before they start a conversation.
widget.suggestionsHint: Up to four. A tap starts a conversation with that question. Drag to reorder.
widget.suggestionsEmpty: No suggestions. Visitors start with an empty message.
widget.attachmentsHint: Visitors can attach, drop or paste files of up to 25 MB.
widget.fileTypesHint: Each file is checked by its contents, not only its name. Programs and scripts are always refused.
widget.noFileTypes: Pick at least one file type, or accept any file.
widget.voiceHint: Visitors record from their microphone, listen back, then send or delete the recording. Works with files turned off.
widget.voiceLengthHint: In seconds, from 5 to 300. Recording stops on its own at this length.
widget.soundHint: A soft chime when a reply arrives while the visitor's tab is in the background.
widget.agentHint: Name, instructions, tools and guardrails are in AI agent settings.
widget.identifyBody: Compute user_hash on your server as the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the user_id, keyed with your widget secret. Never put the secret in browser code. Sessions without a valid hash still work, but are marked unverified.
widget.rotateBody: Identified sessions stop verifying until you deploy the new secret. Existing chats keep working.
widget.rotateMfa: Rotating the secret needs two-factor authentication. Turn on 2FA in Security, then sign in again.
widget.rotateReauth: For safety, sign out and sign back in, then try again. This needs a login from the last 12 hours.
widget.secretLater: An owner can reveal the secret after confirming their sign-in.
widget.secretLaterHint: Rotating the secret shows a new one. Until then, the widget works but cannot verify signed-in users.
widget.newSecretHint: Copy it now and store it on your server. You won't see it again.
widget.secretWarning: Treat it like a password. Anyone with it can impersonate your users in chat.
widget.previewFailed: The preview couldn't load. Your settings still save as usual.
widget.previewHint: This is the real widget with your unsaved changes. Try it: type, tap a suggestion, open a chat.
widget.previewHidden: The widget is hidden on your site. Turn on Show the widget to put it back.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect the tools your team works in. Ollie can then look things up there and, once someone approves, create and update things for you.
integrations.connectedHint: Ollie uses these for everyone in the workspace. Open one to choose its tools.
integrations.catalogHint: Each one is the product's own server. Sign in once for the whole workspace.
integrations.adminsOnly: Ask a workspace admin to connect more.
integrations.disconnectBody: Ollie stops using {{name}} and its sign-in is deleted. Links already on tickets stay.
integrations.connectedToast: Connected. Ollie can use it now.

oauthErrors.sync_failed: Signed in, but the server's tools couldn't be loaded. Try checking for tools again.

tools.autoRunFor: Let Ollie use {{name}} without asking for approval

connect.approval: Ollie only looks things up on its own. Anything that creates or changes something waits for the person who asked to approve it.
